column1: # SEEDS AND WHY: 00276D30 is the REGISTERED HANDLER of the 0x3010 widget built at 0027A42D (`mov edx, 0x3010` ; `lea rcx, [rbx+0xC0]` ; `call 00245000`), so its rcx is the object by construction; the rest are functions it passes the object to in rcx. 0x3010 is also the child stride the-widget-constructor-and-object-sizes.md derives arithmetically for this parent, so the extent is corroborated twice
